description: Expected results for the official OpenGeoSys benchmark Tests/Data/Parabolic/LiquidFlow/GravityDriven (ctest LiquidFlow_GravityDriven, ufz/ogs master commit a5c00a5): steady water pressure in a 1 m x 1 m 2D box under gravity, top held at p = 0. The OFFICIAL reference is the analytic solution stored in the input mesh mesh2D.vtu (point fields AnalyticPressure and v_ref). The official test compares the output fields pressure and v to them with vtkdiff, abs and rel tolerance 1e-8 (ProcessLib/LiquidFlow/Tests.cmake). The expected values for the pressure checks below are read from that official AnalyticPressure field; the tolerance is the official 1e-8.

numeric_checks.name: ogs_return_code
numeric_checks.why: ogs finished normally (KI run_ogs.py status success)

numeric_checks.name: vtkdiff_pressure_vs_AnalyticPressure_rc
numeric_checks.why: official ctest check 1: vtkdiff mesh2D.vtu AnalyticPressure vs output pressure, --abs 1e-8 --rel 1e-8

numeric_checks.name: vtkdiff_v_vs_v_ref_rc
numeric_checks.why: official ctest check 2: vtkdiff mesh2D.vtu v_ref vs output v (Darcy velocity), --abs 1e-8 --rel 1e-8

numeric_checks.name: pressure_max_abs_error_vs_analytic
numeric_checks.why: largest point error of pressure against the official analytic field, official tolerance

numeric_checks.name: v_max_abs_error_vs_v_ref
numeric_checks.why: largest point error of Darcy velocity against the official v_ref (= 0, no flow at hydrostatic state)

numeric_checks.name: pressure_max
numeric_checks.why: bottom pressure rho*g*H = 1000*9.81*1; official AnalyticPressure max

numeric_checks.name: pressure_min
numeric_checks.why: top boundary p = 0; official AnalyticPressure min

numeric_checks.name: pressure_mean
numeric_checks.why: mean over the 409 nodes of official AnalyticPressure

numeric_checks.name: n_output_vtu
numeric_checks.why: prj writes the initial state (ts 0) and the final step (ts 1)

numeric_checks.name: final_time_s
numeric_checks.why: prj t_end = 1 s, one time step

recorded_with: ogs 6.5.7 at /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/OpenGeoSys/venv/bin/ogs, vtkdiff from the same venv, run through KI tools/run_ogs.py with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
notes: Inputs are byte-for-byte the git HEAD files; nothing is changed. OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 is set only in the run environment (default would use all cores); a run with the default 192 threads also passes. Seen in our runs: pressure max abs error 6.9e-11 Pa, velocity max abs error 2.9e-19 m/s.
